milestone.title: M241 future cleanup — direct cycle source + stale fixture

intent.outcome: Close out two follow-ups from the M241 autopilot-tab milestone: (1) TakeoverRow.cycle should read directly from session.queue[].cycle (the real mp source) rather than the max-of-queue_cycle_history derivation it inherited from F-01; (2) the shared sample_session_show fixture in crates/mp/tests/autopilot_manual_refresh.rs should use the real QueueItem shape (milestone_id / stage / cycle) instead of pane-graph keys (label / role / role_skill) so that QueueView::from_session_show produces a non-empty row id when fed the fixture. Both are polish items flagged by the herdr-orc M241 cycle 3 review.

problem.description: Two latent spec/code drift items from M241 surfaced after M230 dropped the render/watch module (forcing render/autopilot_lane.rs to read app.autopilot.picker directly). (1) TakeoverRow.cycle was implemented in M241 round 1 via cycle_from_history(history) — taking the max cycle named in session.queue_cycle_history[]. But mp's real QueueItem (crates/mp/src/autopilot/session.rs:203) already carries cycle: u32 on session.queue[] directly. The F-01 reviewer flagged it as a 'more direct source' judgment call and deferred it as future cleanup. (2) sample_session_show uses pane-graph input (label / role / role_skill) that predates the M240-queue-rename; QueueView::from_session_show reads milestone_id instead, so the fixture's row id comes out empty. It was invisible while the > 1 gate suppressed single-row queues; the M241 F-02 fix made it reachable. Both are correct-and-working today; this milestone cleans them up for the next refactor that touches the area.

in_scope: crates/raul/src/tui/autopilot.rs: change TakeoverRow.cycle population from cycle_from_history(session.queue_cycle_history) to session.queue[].cycle (the matching entry's cycle, or 1 as the same fallback)
crates/mp/tests/autopilot_manual_refresh.rs: update shared sample_session_show to use real QueueItem shape (milestone_id, stage, cycle) so QueueView::from_session_show produces a non-empty row id
Add or update the cycle-source-change test to cover the direct session.queue[].cycle path
Add or update the fixture-shape test to cover the new QueueItem shape
out_of_scope: Any change to crates/mp/src/autopilot/session.rs (QueueItem shape itself)
Any change to render/autopilot_lane.rs layout (M241 spec interpretation 4a stays as-is)
The 1-milestone refresh gate change (M241 F-02 already shipped)
The --force debt on S1.7/S1.1 wrappers (tracked separately as backlog B-88)
M232 cosmetic doc drift (already fixed at f49ebbee1... wait, let me just say 'already fixed in a separate commit')

design_decisions.choice: Use session.queue[].cycle directly (the typed source) instead of session.queue_cycle_history[] (a derived history). session.queue[] carries the same per-row cycle as the M241 takeover row needs; the history is a separate recording channel.
design_decisions.rationale: Direct > derived. Same data, fewer steps, easier to reason about. The cycle_from_history function and its 2-space 'M' prefix normalization can be deleted.

design_decisions.choice: Update only the queue-related fields in the fixture (milestone_id / stage / cycle). Leave pane-graph keys (label / role / role_skill) alone in pane_graph input.
design_decisions.rationale: scope discipline. The fixture's purpose is test surface for QueueView; pane_graph is a separate concern and out of scope.
